metadata.title: Putting the 19% gain in SpaceX stock in perspective — it's very rare - MarketWatch

content.text:
2 days ago
Putting the 19% gain in SpaceX stock in perspective — it's very rare
Some investors may express disappointment in the 19.2% first-day gain in SpaceX's stock, considering it was up as much as 30.8% at the intraday high, and since Tesla's stock had a first-day pop of 41%.
But consider this. SpaceX is now only the second company with a trillion-dollar market capitalization to see its stock rise so much, according to Dow Jones Market Data. The only other time that happened, Meta Platforms, which had a market cap of just over $1 trillion on Feb. 1, 2024, saw its stock soar 20.3% the next day.
SpaceX started the day with a $1.8 trillion market cap, and ended the day with a $2.1 trillion market cap.
